notes: Official multi-arch image yunique001/elizabeth:2.0.2 publishes linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.

The `images[].digest` value is the multi-arch index digest. Per-platform manifest digests are read from `docker buildx imagetools inspect <reference>` and are deliberately not duplicated here, because they change with every build and a copied hash would outlive the build it describes.

The distroless runtime reports 0 CRITICAL and 0 HIGH findings under trivy. The earlier Debian-based runtime published as 2.0.1 reported 3 CRITICAL and 59 HIGH, and the bare debian:trixie-slim base reports 0 CRITICAL and 43 HIGH, so removing the userland clears the findings instead of waiting for point releases.
The runtime stage is gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian13, pinned by digest. It ships the C runtime, CA certificates, and timezone data only.

The previous runtime base (debian:trixie-slim) shipped perl-base 5.40.1-6, which carried CVE-2026-13221, CVE-2026-42496, and CVE-2026-8376. The distroless runtime removes perl and the rest of the Debian userland rather than relying on a point release.
The image contains no shell, package manager, perl, util-linux, or curl, so container exec cannot open a shell and the healthcheck uses the bundled `board health` probe.
The container runs as the non-root user 65532:65532. scripts/init.sh hands ./data and ./storage to that user with mode 0750 before Compose starts.
SQLite state is persisted under /app/data; room uploads are persisted under /app/storage.
Container hardening matches the upstream compose: read_only, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, and /tmp tmpfs.
JWT_SECRET uses a required random 1Panel password field instead of a weak fixed production secret.

The project relicensed from the custom `Elizabeth Restricted License (ERL) v1.0` to AGPL-3.0-only in 2.0.2. The previous text was not an OSI-approved license and blocked redistribution, which is why the package carries `licenseEvidence` from this version on.
The `document` metadata link intentionally stays on the default branch so it survives releases.
